title: Slow-tier validation attempt -- refused at night by the vio_active gate
outcome: NOT RUN. The closed-loop segment was refused before any motion command. Gate armed and disarmed; mower ended stationary, blades off.

step1_first_pulse_refused.error: RuntimeError: BLE link stopped being ready before motion dispatch: command_queue_backlogged
step1_first_pulse_refused.note: Guard refused dispatch on a backlogged BLE command queue. A 24.5 cm position change in the same window was NOT ours (command never dispatched) and was not used as a heading -- most likely residual app-driven positioning.

step3_dry_run.note: angular_speed 0 -- a straight forward command. No turn planned.

step4_real_run_refused.detail: VIO turn mode requires an active VIO track (vio_state == 2); saw 0. Scene is dark.
step4_real_run_refused.analysis: The gate keys off turn_mode == vio, not off whether a turn is actually needed. _VIO_TURN_MODES is (vio, legacy) only -- there is no night-safe turn mode. passed = dry_run or calibration_will_warm, and calibration_will_warm requires a bright scene. So a closed-loop segment cannot run after dark, by design.

side_finding_heading_formula.conclusion: Independent confirmation, from a clean attributable 0.45 m displacement, that the mirror relation is right and the additive offset constant is not. The 116.5 constant mis-aims by 9.8 deg here; the mirror agrees within 0.89 deg.
